analysis:
This PR changes only documentation: docs/architecture/inference.md and docs/provider/cli-reference.md. No source, wire protocol, key handling, attestation, or authorization code changes are in the supplied evidence.

inference.md patch (head lines ~1129-1141): adds prose on Qwen inline-assistant MTP chained ordinary decode. The target forward returns hidden rows, finalize appends them to the assistant history, and the carry is stored. Two rollback env switches are named: DARKBLOOM_TTFT_QWEN_MTP_CHAINED and DARKBLOOM_TTFT_QWEN_MTP_CARRY. This describes in-process engine state and speculation behavior. It is relevant to TB-007 and T-028 (residual GPU/KV data) and T-041 (prefix cache), but the text adds no new persistence, no on-disk artifact, and no change to cache scoping, HMAC naming, TTL, or the encryption posture. The new carry and history are in-memory assistant state, so no at-rest exposure or cross-tenant channel is introduced by the documentation. I could not verify the underlying source (EngineLoopV2+MTPOrdinaryHistory.swift). Whether carry or history state crosses request boundaries, or interacts with prefix-cache restore, is a code-level question outside the supplied evidence. The prose says carry is stored once no successor is in flight and is seeded from the final prompt row, which appears request-local.

cli-reference.md patch: documents the benchmark flags --runtime-concurrency and --runtime-stagger for RuntimeConcurrencyBenchmark. These are local CLI developer or benchmark options. The runtime-generation benchmark is documented as running with the prefix cache off, so it does not touch the SSD cache. The benchmark emits per-row tokens and text as JSON, which is local operator output, as the existing --runtime-generation already does. Nothing here touches consumer prompts through the coordinator.

The other view chunks (inference.md lines 1234-1790) are unchanged context with no changed ranges in the supplied map. I found nothing in them that is new or regressive.

No findings. Remaining question for a code-level pass: confirm that the chained MTP history and carry in EngineLoopV2+MTPOrdinaryHistory.swift are request-scoped and cleared on retirement (T-028), and that the benchmark flags are not reachable from coordinator-served requests.
